idea-plugin.name: Lucene Query Injection Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a QueryBuilders.queryStringQuery(...)/ .simpleQueryStringQuery(...) call whose argument is built from an HTTP endpoint parameter -- CWE-943 (an attacker's raw input becomes Lucene query SOURCE TEXT, enabling filter bypass) combined with CWE-400: CVE-2023-31419 confirms a real Denial of Service via a maliciously crafted query string against Elasticsearch's own _search API (Stack Overflow from deeply nested query syntax).

Built on a real, hand-written Lucene query-string parser -- the FIFTH full custom grammar in this catalog (after regex, SpEL, XPath, and LDAP). Introduces range queries ([1 TO 10]), boosting (term^2.0), and fuzzy matching (term~2) -- operators none of the other four grammars have.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only Java, only same-method taint; searched explicitly for a CodeQL/Datadog rule for this exact angle and found none (unlike SQL injection, which both cover extensively) -- no dedicated Marketplace plugin found either.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
